question: Which of the following sports personalities received the Padma Shri in 2024 for their contribution to sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joshna Chinappa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Joshna Chinappa is an Indian professional squash player who has achieved significant milestones in her career.
 
• She became the first Indian to win the British Squash Championship title in 2003 in the under-19 category.
 
• Joshna has been a prominent figure in Indian squash, winning numerous national and international titles.
 
• In 2024, she was honored with the Padma Shri award for her outstanding contributions to the sport of squash.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri Award**

 
 
• It is the fourth highest civilian award in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• The award is conferred on individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Shri are announced every year on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Squash**
 
 
• Squash is a fast-paced racquet sport played by two players in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.
 
• The game requires agility, strategy, and endurance.
 
• It is recognized by the International Olympic Committee and has been included in various multi-sport events such as the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games.
 
 
 
• **India's Achievements in Squash**
 
 
• India has produced several top-ranked squash players like Saurav Ghosal, Dipika Pallikal, and Joshna Chinappa.
 
• The country has been making significant progress in the sport with players achieving success in international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **British Squash Championship**
 
 
• One of the oldest and most prestigious squash tournaments in the world.
 
• Winning this championship is considered a major achievement in the sport of squash.
